parameters.content:
### {{CLINIC_NAME}} - Future Follow-ups Scheduler (PET WF9)

**🎯 Purpose:** AI-powered follow-up scheduling with automated daily reminders

**🚀 Key Features:**
• **AI Analysis:** Analyzes visit notes to identify future care needs
• **Smart Scheduling:** Automatically schedules follow-ups based on visit type and pet needs
• **Daily Reminders:** Sends SMS reminders for actions due today
• **Comprehensive Tracking:** Maintains detailed follow-up database
• **Admin Reports:** Daily summary emails for clinic management

**⚡ Workflow Process:**
1. **Visit Completion Trigger:** Activated when a visit is completed (from WF4)
2. **AI Analysis:** Uses OpenAI to analyze visit notes and identify follow-up needs
3. **Follow-up Scheduling:** Creates future actions with specific due dates
4. **Database Storage:** Saves all follow-up actions to Google Sheets
5. **Daily Monitoring:** Checks for actions due today at 8 AM
6. **Reminder System:** Sends SMS reminders to clients for due actions
7. **Status Tracking:** Updates follow-up status after reminders sent
8. **Admin Reporting:** Sends daily summary to clinic administrators

**🤖 AI Capabilities:**
• Analyzes visit notes for vaccination schedules
• Identifies medication refill needs
• Schedules preventive care reminders
• Recognizes breed-specific health requirements
• Suggests follow-up intervals based on age and condition

**📊 Follow-up Types:**
• Vaccination reminders (6-month, annual)
• Medication refills
• Dental cleanings
• Weight checks
• Senior pet wellness exams
• Breed-specific screenings
• Post-surgery follow-ups

**🔄 Integration Points:**
• Triggered by: Visit Completion Workflow (WF4)
• Follow-up Database: {{FUTURE_FOLLOWUPS_SHEET_ID}}
• SMS Reminders: Twilio integration
• Email Reports: SMTP integration
• AI Analysis: OpenAI GPT integration

**⚙️ Configuration:**
• Clinic: {{CLINIC_NAME}}
• Daily Check Time: 8:00 AM ({{TIMEZONE}})
• Contact: {{BUSINESS_PHONE_NUMBER}} / {{BUSINESS_EMAIL}}
• Admin Notifications: {{ADMIN_EMAIL}}
• Sheet: {{FOLLOWUPS_SHEET_NAME}}
